sources.title: Striking unions at Antofagasta’s Centinela copper mine reach preliminary deal, ending strike
evidence: Workers from two striking unions at Antofagasta’s Centinela copper mine in Chile reached a preliminary agreement for a new collective contract agreement, agreeing to end a strike that has lasted more than a week at the mine
which will then be put to a ratifying vote on Saturday.

sources.title: Progress toward a US-Mexico tariff deal has stalled, WSJ reports
evidence: Progress toward a US-Mexico tariff deal has stalled after opposition from Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, the Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday
Lutnick has opposed significant reductions in the 25% tariff on Mexican automobiles and the 50% levies on steel and aluminum
Mexico’s deputy trade minister Luis Rosendo Gutierrez told the Journal there was progress in the negotiations

sources.title: IEA Governing Board statement on energy markets and security
evidence: Acknowledged that approximately 330 million barrels have so far been released and agreed to take all necessary steps to complete the remaining releases of around 100 million barrels in a timely manner consistent with national circumstances.
making the total amount of stocks to be released exceed the original total of 400 million barrels.
Agreed to accelerate the release of the remaining volumes, with specific plans already in place including over 20 million barrels of diesel as soon as possible.
